title: Paul travels from Troas to Macedonia
description: Paul tells that when he came to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ, a door was opened for him in the Lord. Yet he found no rest in his spirit because he did not meet his brother Titus there. Therefore he said goodbye to them and went on to Macedonia [ref:2 Cor 2:12-13|2 Corinthians 2:12-13].
